title: Use of Multiple Machine Learning Approaches for Selecting Urothelial Cancer-Specific DNA Methylation Biomarkers in Urine.
authors: Kohler, Christina U; Schork, Karin; Turewicz, Michael; Eisenacher, Martin; Roghmann, Florian; Noldus, Joachim; Marcus, Katrin; Bruning, Thomas; Kafferlein, Heiko U
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习筛选尿液DNA甲基化标志物用于膀胱癌诊断，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diagnosing urothelial cancer (UCa) via invasive cystoscopy is painful, specifically in men, and can cause infection and bleeding. Because the UCa risk is higher for male patients, urinary non-invasive UCa biomarkers are highly desired to stratify men for invasive cystoscopy. We previously identified multiple DNA methylation sites in urine samples that detect UCa with a high sensitivity and specificity in men. Here, we identified the most relevant markers by employing multiple statistical approaches and machine learning (random forest, boosted trees, LASSO) using a dataset of 251 male UCa patients and 111 controls. Three CpG sites located in ALOX5, TRPS1 and an intergenic region on chromosome 16 have been concordantly selected by all approaches, and their combination in a single decision matrix for clinical use was tested based on their respective thresholds of the individual CpGs. The combination of ALOX5 and TRPS1 yielded the best overall sensitivity (61%) at a pre-set specificity of 95%. This combination exceeded both the diagnostic performance of the most sensitive bioinformatic approach and that of the best single CpG. In summary, we showed that overlap analysis of multiple statistical approaches identifies the most reliable biomarkers for UCa in a male collective. The results may assist in stratifying men for cystoscopy.
abstract_zh: 通过侵入性膀胱镜检查诊断尿路上皮癌（UCa）是痛苦的，尤其是在男性中，并可能导致感染和出血。由于男性患者患UCa的风险较高，因此高度需要非侵入性尿液UCa生物标志物，以对男性进行分层，决定是否进行侵入性膀胱镜检查。我们此前在尿液样本中识别出多个DNA甲基化位点，这些位点能在男性中高灵敏度和特异性检测UCa。在本研究中，我们使用包含251名男性UCa患者和111名对照者的数据集，通过多种统计方法和机器学习（随机森林、提升树、LASSO）识别出最相关的标志物。位于ALOX5、TRPS1和16号染色体上一个基因间区域的三个CpG位点被所有方法一致选择，并且它们在一个用于临床的单一决策矩阵中的组合，基于各个CpG的各自阈值进行了测试。ALOX5和TRPS1的组合在预设95%特异性下产生了最佳总体灵敏度（61%）。该组合超过了最敏感的生物信息学方法的诊断性能，也优于最佳单个CpG。总之，我们表明，多种统计方法的重叠分析能识别出男性群体中最可靠的UCa生物标志物。这些结果可能有助于对男性进行膀胱镜检查的分层。
